name: HH breakout 15 — expansion-continuation pullback, slow trend (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same two-stage logic — enter on a low-cost pullback INTO a confirmed post-expansion trend rather than chasing the break — but on a 4h clock so the confirmed regime is a multi-day trend and the pullback is a swing retracement, a distinct hold/frequency cell from the 1h version. Gate: bb_width expanded above a floor (the squeeze has resolved) AND adx in trend territory, then enter long when range_position pulls back below a mid-range ceiling AND a shallow recent return (ret_Nd over a short lookback) is negative-but-not-a-reversal (the retest pause). The ret_Nd pullback gauge is the distinct entry-timing filter here (vs the pure range_position pullback of variant 14). Counterparty: swing fakeout-faders shorting the pullback into a real multi-day trend. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the pullback resumes the trend no more often than it reverts to the full range net of fees, OR if the ret_Nd retest filter is decorative (a plain range_position pullback gives the same result → not distinct from variant 14), OR if the two-stage entry does not beat the one-stage break, OR if adx/ret_Nd smoothing leaks (verify PIT).
catalyst: swing pullback within a confirmed multi-day post-expansion trend
